poc_scope: Objective: validate Redwood Dedicated can meet 95p latency <150ms for chat + 99.9% availability during business hours; verify canary + fallback routing with model variants and region failover; demonstrate cost-saving via caching/quantization. Duration: 4 weeks. Acceptance criteria: (1) canary rollout at 5-20% traffic with telemetry and automated rollback if error rate >1% or lat 95p increases >40%; (2) fallback routing successfully shifts traffic to L6-quantized model within 30s when primary pool overloaded; (3) region failover documented and tested between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with <120s cutover; (4) per-route token and cost reports match projected burn within ±15%.
technical_requirements: Workload: mixed chat + embeddings + reranking. Targets: steady-state throughput 50 req/s, burst to 200 req/s for short windows. Latency SLO: chat 95p <150ms; embeddings median <60ms. Model profile: prefer open Llama-2-Chat style variants for hosted tests; plan Dedicated to use quantized L6 variant for cost fallback and an FP16 L7 for latency-critical routes. Routing: policy must support weighted canary, automatic fallback to cheaper variant, region-based routing with health checks, and immediate circuit-breaker for high error rates. Observability: token breakdown, per-request traces, KV cache hit rates, per-model P95 latency charts. Security: VPC peering, SAML SSO sign-on, KMS integration for key rotation, audit log retention 1 year.
pricing_discussion: Initial pricing conversation: customer comfortable with committed reserved capacity model if discounts applied for 12-month commit. Target ARR band $100k-$200k. Key asks: transparent per-route cost modeling, option to cap spend, trial credits applied to first month, and a clear path to convert Hosted usage credits toward Dedicated commit. Procurement wants a line-item security addendum. AE suggested mid-tier Dedicated package + Optimize advisory add-on.
canary_plan_summary: Planned canary: start 5% traffic -> 20% over 3 days if metrics stable. Monitors: lat 95p, error rate, token burn, user-perceived degradation (downstream app error rate). Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained for 3m, lat 95p increase >40% vs baseline, KV cache miss spike >3x. Rollback action: automatic routing switch back to baseline model variant + alert to SE + manual postmortem. Fallback routing: during capacity pressure route to quantized L6 model in same region; if region health unhealthy, shift to secondary region (eu-west-1) with geo-dns and regional routing policy. Cutover steps documented in Runbook v1 attached in Drive.
implementation_notes: SE will provision Dedicated test pool with small GPU nodes; use prefix caching + informed batching. Plan to exercise long-tail tokens by replaying production-like sessions (anonymized). Will run chaos scenario: simulated node loss in us-east-1 to validate region failover. Team to capture latency and token counts with trace ids for side-by-side cost analysis. Security team requires proof-of-concept KMS key rotation flow before go-live.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: procurement stalls on price => mitigation: propose 6-month pilot with usage cap and escrowed credits. Risk: cross-region data residency concerns => mitigation: ensure embeddings hashed and residency enforced for EU requests; demonstrate region-only storage. Risk: unexpected tail latency => mitigation: reduce batch sizes for latency-critical routes and enable immediate fallback to smaller model variant.
